title: Make MQTT overlay edge coverage time-safe
description: The full Python quality suite currently fails on develop in tests/test_router_edge_coverage.py::test_mqtt_import_connect_publish_and_overlay_edge_paths. The test creates an envelope with a fixed 2026-09-17 timestamp and a 60-second lease, then record_envelope prunes it against real current time before overlay_events is evaluated at event_time + 1 second. Make the test deterministic without weakening the intended coverage; retain meaningful expiry behavior. Add focused validation and report tests. This is a live issue-router test: preserve all agent reasoning and results on the issue, use a draft PR, and leave the issue in Review when finished.
